name: Where a material is kept in B144
description: the storage unit, sublocation, zone and tube label for a material in B144, found by its name or by what people actually call it — "the green tube", "B buffer", "sequencing primer"
phrases: where do we keep the polymerase
what box is that reagent in
returns: one block per match: name, tube label, storage unit / sublocation, zone, and the note that explains what it is. --json gives {query, hits:[{name, exact, category, storage_unit, sublocation, zone, label, synonyms, notes, concentration}]}. Exit 1 and a sentence when the MODEL does not name it, which is not the same as the shelf being empty.

requires.note: the materials and their synonyms. The synonyms column is what makes this answer a spoken question rather than a catalogue lookup.

notes: SYNONYMS ARE THE POINT. A student asks for the green tube, not for PrimeStar PCR Buffer, and locations.tsv carries both. Reads the site's own loader (docs/tools/lab/js/data.js) rather than parsing the TSVs again, so there is one answer to the quoting and column questions rather than two.
